raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.1.0"

package:
  name: qiskit-sphinx-theme
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/q/qiskit-sphinx-theme/qiskit_sphinx_theme-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5abd24d33dfe6488d3fc8e9e48905592b36366ad304bb3ce09c3f95b7320dfb0

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - sphinx-theme-builder >=0.2.0b2
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - docutils
    - sphinx >=7.0,<10.0
    - furo ==2025.12.19

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - qiskit_sphinx_theme
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: A Sphinx theme for Qiskit and Qiskit Ecosystem projects
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/qiskit-sphinx-theme/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - wshanks
